rules.STRUCTURAL_NOISE: empty/punctuation-only, heading-only, known label, or <=5 alphanumeric/CJK characters
rules.STANDALONE_USEFUL_EVIDENCE: contains sentence punctuation or at least 18 alphanumeric/CJK characters
rules.AMBIGUOUS: short content not resolved by the conservative structural rules

metric_definitions.conditional_recall: mean query-level recall over gold refs whose parent post is in the frozen Top10 post pool
metric_definitions.final_evidence_recall: mean query-level recall over all frozen answerable gold refs
metric_definitions.chunk_mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first selected item covering any query gold ref
metric_definitions.gold_removed_rate: conditional gold refs absent from the strategy's candidate pool
metric_definitions.gold_harmed_rate: conditional gold refs selected by frozen baseline but absent from strategy Top10
metric_definitions.duplicate_slot_waste: selected Top10 slots equivalent to an earlier selected content item
